title: PDA
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office grapples with issues of romance and PDA, including discussions about office policies, romantic relationships, and Valentine's Day plans. Michael and Holly's relationship is a central focus, with moments of affection, conflict, and eventual declaration of moving in together. The episode also features Darryl reflecting on his grandmother and humorous exchanges about puzzles and love.
